text: Thus, the world, asleep due to the practice of duality, delusion, and latent impressions, perceives the unreal as if it were a dream, and, not being awake, does not fully comprehend its non-existence. However, when one becomes awake through the attainment of knowledge that is beyond duality, transcending the world, and free from alternatives, then, in the presence of that knowledge, which is pure, attained through reflection, and worldly, one fully comprehends the non-existence of objects. This is the same.
